words: The approver checked 140 of the 2,000 items in the asker's batch.
They were chosen by Bitcoin block 977713, mined after the batch was fixed, so neither side picked them.
The plan: check 140, and accept the batch only if none fall short. If more than 40 of the 2,000 fell short, this plan would pass the batch at most 1 time in 20.
If more than 40 of the 2,000 fell short, a draw of 140 as clean as this one would come up at most 1 time in 20.
This is not a guarantee: the other 1,860 items were not seen.
It does not show that the items are good — only that the approver checked these 140 and answered.
A draw finds only what a person can see in an item.
It says nothing about who made the items.
